Mozart's Requiem II. Kyrie 6. Lacrimosa

Lacrimosa dies illa
(Mournful that day)
qua resurget ex favilla
(when from the ahses shall rise)
judicandus homo reus.
(guilty man to be judged)

Lacrimosa dies illa
(Mournful that day)
qua resurget ex favilla
(when from the ahses shall rise)
judicandus homo reus.
(guilty man to be judged)

Huic ergo parce, Deus,
(Lord, have mercy on him)
pie Jesu Domine,
(gentle Lord Jesus)

dona eis
(grant them)
requiem
(eternal rest)
dona eis requiem.
(grant them eternal rest)

Amen.
